title: payload-tuner settings
description: Schema for extensionSettings.payloadTuner in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json. USER layer only — the project layer is ignored entirely (ADR-0106; a repo's .pi/settings.json must not steer sampling or strip thinking on local models). Documentation-only — pi does not run runtime schema validation; lib/settings.ts is the runtime parser and fails closed to disabled on any malformed input.

enabled.description: Master toggle. The extension is inert unless this is exactly true AND at least one valid rule exists.

rules.description: Ordered rule list; the FIRST rule whose match block matches the resolved model wins. A malformed rule disables the whole extension (fail-closed parsing).

match.description: Model predicate — every present field must match (AND). Values support `*` as a multi-character wildcard, anchored to the whole value. Matched against ctx.model at request time.

apply.description: Request-option tweaks. All are non-prefix wire fields — messages/system/tools are never touched (ADR-0106 invariant).

chatTemplateKwargs.description: Merged into the payload's `chat_template_kwargs` (oMLX/vLLM-style servers), e.g. {"enable_thinking": false}. Must stay stable turn-to-turn within a session (server-side template churn would defeat the oMLX prefix cache).

maxTokensCap.description: Upper bound applied to `max_tokens` / `max_completion_tokens` / `max_output_tokens` when the adapter emitted one. Only ever lowers; never raises and never adds the field. `max_output_tokens` (Responses API family) is floored at 16 — the API rejects lower values (ADR-0110).
